hidden_Li6.policy: retain prescribed saved history; no new calibration

profiles.zero_semantics: negligible population/source-onset idealization, not exact physical absence
profiles.D_charge_choice: isotope-blind residual copied from H, consistent with current electronic rates; charge-exchange equilibrium not imposed

D_H.status: historical observational primordial estimate Cooke2018; not latest-combined constraint

He4_H.status: rounded adopted primordial-like total; compare BBN Yp0.24709 not direct He/H measurement

He3_H.status: rounded BBN-motivated model total, not precision observation

Li7_H.status: rounded standard-BBN-like model total; stellar plateau alternative not equal evidence

x_HII.status: illustrative residual ionization of order few 1e-4

x_LiI.status: illustrative small neutral fraction; no numerical fit/digitization of primary Figure3

Tgas.status: illustrative cold IGM temperature; donor actually300K

x_DII.status: adopted isotope-blind residual initialization consistent with current equal H/D electronic rates; not a physical freeze-out measurement

nuisance_brackets.x_DII: [0,x_HII]; charge-exchange formula is conditional interior choice
nuisance_brackets.interpretation: sensitivity intervals, not confidence or joint posterior; zero high-ion tails are controlled approximations, not physical impossibility

preexisting_source_alternative.B_j: integral_pre_t0 S_j(s) exp[-integral_s^t0 L_j du] ds plus surviving earlier stock
preexisting_source_alternative.U_j: same with kinetic-power P_j; constant-history QSS gives B=S/L,U=P/L
preexisting_source_alternative.thermal: use causal five-stock transition solution; frozen QSS only when earlier history has relaxed
preexisting_source_alternative.source_support: actual pre-t0 history not available; do not assert source-onset zero and relaxed nonzero QSS simultaneously

adapter_requirements: Explicit profile selection; default stays legacy reproduction
Recompute initial charge including B_T and prescribed hidden Li6
Recompute thermal energy from chosen temperature and particle count
Replace/reconstruct prescribed electron and temperature dependent rates for cold profile
Supply compatible initial photons and photo hazards; include recombination-distortion Li-ionizing component or label omission
Preserve time origin and no implicit prehistory
Record initial excess kinetic energy with fast stocks
Track particle/baryon normalization with open sources; do not rescale y to sum A*y=1
Do not replace D residual with conditional charge-exchange equilibrium unless corresponding kinetics and timescale are supplied

execution.scientific_cpu_cost: NOT_MEASURED; no solver invoked; no zero-cost claim

conditional_D_equilibrium.status: NOT_DEFAULT; only after adding charge-exchange kinetics and showing equilibration; may be slow at8K

electron.definition: sum q_i y_i + B_T + sum q_hidden*y_hidden; not independent scalar IC

CMB.status: standard blackbody temperature-law assumption; not saved finite UV packet

UV.status: separate source/history field; no universal IC amplitude inferred from CMB

neutrino.status: conditional standard instantaneous-decoupling reference; masses, distortions and angular stress not supplied

dark_matter.status: density plus particle mass/distribution/velocity moments required; not determined by nuclear abundance table

auxiliary_IC.anisotropic_stress: not fixed by these scalar ICs; companion Bianchi lane owns angular moments
